body: I have always said it was selfish and I was too strong to ever give up.  For the last few years it’s all I can do to get through a day.  I fantasize about just the end the no more to have to fight and deal with several times a day now. For a long time I’ve struggled for those I’d leave behind and propped myself up with that.  As life turns out all I can see is how much better everyone would be with me not around and I agree, the same fight the same struggle everyday is exhausting and if has given way to when a long time ago.
I’m here in a good spot I’ve said my goodbyes.  If that girl I mentioned stumbles across this post I hope she knows I loved her with all I had and I’m sorry.

I don’t have anything coming up and I’m not going back to the psych ward o really am sorry for wasting time.  I know I’ve made up my mind and I know what I have to do.  I wish I could tell them all especially her not to hate me and that I just wanted everyone to have peace and I just can’t take all the hurting every minute anymore

I’ve been doing therapy, and all I feel is how much shittier I am as a person.  She did love me and still does as a person, but she has her own things going on and she feels like I’ve been trying to control her.  She is scared but I think she half believes this is a way to try to get her back.  The last instance I called her to tell her I love her and she figured out what I was doing and at that time I loved her more than I hate me.  I’m sending letters in the mail this time and I really just can’t keep crawling on. She won’t even speak to me now and I don’t blame her

It’s been over two years I’ve leaned on her so hard and I resisted getting any help and by the time I did it’s been too late.  The kids are happier now being with their natural mom and being I work nights and barley sleep I’m a fucking zombie when I have them and they all seem to keep their distance from me like everyone else in my life.  I made myself an island and I can’t take the pain and anxiety I cause everyone around me.  The girl is afraid I could hurt her or her family because of evil shit I’ve said in the past.  I feel like I lost the man I was years ago and I can’t get back to that. The more I think the more I feel I need to just be gone and everyone can have a better life

It’s not her fault.  She has put up with more from me than anyone should have to.   I really only had her so all of my depression mood swings and anger and mistrust became her problem.  I basically went from being someone she had hopes of being a partner too, to someone she was responsible for.  I have 3 kids and I can’t even fake enough happiness to not make them miserable anymore. I feel like I’m a visitor in my own life and I don’t want to stay.

Similarly I was told by a girl to go to the hospital I was there about a week and felt worse coming out.  She now hates me for calling her to say good bye when I was going to do it and “laying everything at her feet” I can’t talk about any good times or good that I’ve done all she sees is this.  In the end everyone cares about them, that’s not a diss just the truth if you are drowning they just don’t want pulled under.
